objectives.title: Seeds Spawn
objectives.description: Queen Nightshade will periodically summon a Seed. Defeat its Shambler Defenders and gather it for your team!

objectives.title: Collect Seeds
objectives.description: Upon gathering three Seeds, Garden Terrors will immediately burrow to each lane.

objectives.title: Garden Terrors
objectives.description: Garden Terrors disable enemy Structures, so fight alongside them!
